summary: Learn ADKAR and Prosci change tools in 5 days. Build adoption plans, manage resistance, and report change progress with confidence.
lede: ADKAR training helps professionals plan and assess how people adopt organizational change. It is designed for change practitioners, project and program managers, HR professionals, and transformation teams who need practical adoption plans. Learners practise readiness and impact assessment, sponsor and stakeholder mapping, communication planning, resistance management, reinforcement, and adoption reporting using the ADKAR model and Prosci 3-Phase Process.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support adoption, sponsor engagement, communication planning, and resistance management across change initiatives.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of projects, programmes, or operational change within an organization. No coding is required, but you should be prepared to work with templates, stakeholder maps, communication plans, and simple adoption measures. Prior exposure to change projects, process improvement, or people-facing coordination roles will help you apply the exercises quickly.
